description: This is a Python script for generating XML structure files based on Android audio header files and structure XML files. It parses Android audio configuration headers, maps criteria, and produces a formatted XML output.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input/output files and verbosity.

methods.name: findBitPos
methods.description: Finds the position of a bit set in a decimal number, with special handling for multiple bits.

methods.name: generateXmlStructureFile
methods.description: Generates an XML structure file based on component type dictionary and input XML template.

methods.name: capitalizeLine
methods.description: Capitalizes each word in a line.

methods.name: parseAndroidAudioFile
methods.description: Parses Android audio header file to extract device and stream criteria, mapping them to internal representations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates argument parsing, parsing Android header, and generating XML.
